sources.note: Main website — positions KanTime as #1 Home Health and Hospice Enterprise EMR. Lists care types: home health, hospice, palliative, pediatric, private duty, self-directed. Key metrics: 912K patients, 210K users, $12.9B claims processed, 70M annual visits.

Lists HITRUST r2, SOC 2 Type 2, ONC Health IT, Surescripts, ACHC, CHAP certifications. Describes core modules: intake, scheduling, clinical POC, billing, HR/payroll, IDT management, EVV, business intelligence.

Company history: Kanrad Technologies founded 1997 as IT consulting, rebranded to KanTime 2010. Private Duty launched 2010, Home Health 2012 (first client Anova), Hospice 2016, Self-Directed 2018. CEO Sundar Kannan.
Home health product page — describes intake, scheduling, clinical POC with autofill, order tracking, eligibility/authorization management, billing, HR/payroll. Web-based integrated platform.

Hospice product page — IDT management, bereavement management, volunteer tracking (5% requirement), auto-generated 485 plans of care, HIS collection, hospice benefit period management, electronic physician order faxing.
Scheduling features — split shift management, Clinician Search Wizard (geographic/skill-based matching), drag-and-drop scheduling, real-time calendars, ad hoc visit tracking, late clock-in alerts.

E-prescribing (KRx) module — DEA-certified EPCS, Surescripts pharmacy network integration, on-demand medication history (1 year), drug-to-drug and drug-allergy checking via FirstDataBank, 24/7 mobile prescribing.
Payroll as a Service — clinician lock pay period, dispute resolution, payment preview system, centralized payroll portal. Integrates with scheduling and billing suite.

Partner integrations — billing (Availity, Change Healthcare, Waystar, Ability), payroll (ADP, BambooHR, Ceridian, etc.), EVV (CellTrak, CareBridge), pharmacy (AvantumRx, BetterRx), supplies (Cardinal Health, Capstone HME), referrals (CarePort, Cipher Health). EVV integrated across all 50 states + D.C.

Third-party review site — lists intake, clinical POC, scheduling, billing/coding, IDT management, HR/payroll as key modules. 24 reviews averaging 4/5 stars. Notes implementation complexity as common complaint.
Third-party listing — confirms cloud-based platform serving home health and hospice since 2007. Notes billing lifecycle management, scheduling engine, mobile app, HR/payroll features.
SelectHub ranks KanTime #4 on top 10 Home Health Software leaderboard. Competitors include Alora, ClearPath, Easy Living, B-Homecare Agency.

EMR features overview page — content did not render fully but navigation confirmed modules: intake, eligibility, authorizations, scheduling, clinical POC, order tracking, QA, billing/coding, IDT management, HR/payroll.
Press release about self-directed care launch — KanTime for Self Direction serves FMSAs, F/EAs, Agencies with Choice, FIs, FSEs. Complete documentation, audit trails, state/federal compliance.
